host.unit: Center for Technology Entrepreneurship, University of Washington Business School

highlights: The founding symposium, initiated by Suresh Kotha, Kathleen Eisenhardt, and Alan Meyer.
Opening session “Entrepreneurship Research: Trends and Future Directions” with S. Venkataraman, University of Virginia, on what gets sent to and published in the Journal of Business Venturing.
The only program to include paper abstracts.
